caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair rendered in black ink or pencil, centered on a plain, off-white background. The chair has a slat back composed of three vertical, turned spindles inserted into a curved upper rail and joined with thicker, decorative posts on each side, which connect the backrest to the seat. The seat of the chair is flat and slightly trapezoidal in shape. The legs are splayed and also turned, connected by multiple horizontal stretchers for stability. All components of the chair—including the legs, spindles, and stretchers—are detailed with careful shading and texture to suggest the grain and shape of wood. The artist's signature, "Violet Hartenstein," is written in small, simple print below the chair near the bottom edge of the drawing. The overall composition is simple, with ample negative space around the chair, and the entire image is monochromatic, using shades of black to create detail and contrast against the cream-colored background.
title: Child's Chair
